rows.en: Touya: "You're kidding... Ymir's been abducted...?"
Ivel: "...She was protecting me..."
Emy: "Ymir... It can't be..."
Celica: "Oh, but we can find out where Ymir is right away."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Celica: "Well, I secretly put a tracking beacon on her."
Touya: "A tracking beacon...? What gave you that idea...?"
Celica: "I thought something like this might happen.
Heh heh, I've always wanted to say that."
Touya: "...Don't tell me you've put them on us, too?"
Touya: "You have?!"
Celica: "But... I worry about you."
Xiujian: "...That's an invasion of privacy.
It helped this time, so I'll let it go, but in future
I would like you to refrain from doing that."
Celica: "...Okaaay."
Arthur: "In that case, let's set out at once.
We don't know the enemy's objective, and there's no guarantee Ymir
is safe."
Celica: "You're right. We can repair Zeulear
aboard Liebhofen.
As long as we have the materials, we can manage."
Touya: "All right! Let's go!"
Ymir: "We managed to drive them off safely."
Ivel: "Just what does Zigrim stand to gain
by doing this...?"
Emy: "My dear Ymir and Lady Ivel...
How dare those insolent people try to harm you!
We should lodge a protest at once!"
Ivel: "We have no evidence.
They'll just keep denying any knowledge of it until the matter is swept aside."
Emy: "Then are you saying we should wait for them to come again?"
Ivel: "I don't think that mercenary band will use the same trick.
And if their employer is Zigrim, as we suspect,
it's unlikely those people will be hired again.
They've already failed once.
In other words, we can expect the chances of another attack on the Holy Land
to be extremely low."
Touya: "Well, whatever the case, I'm glad you're safe."
Arthur: "For now, there's the matter of repairing Zeulear, too,
so let's stay here in the Holy Land for the rest of today."
Ivel: "Yes. The lodgings you used before
are vacant, so please make yourselves at home.
And Ymir, you should rest, too."
Ymir: "What? But the investigation..."
Ivel: "You push yourself too hard.
Take at least today to relax at home.
Melvi is waiting for you, too."
Ymir: "Understood.
I'll take you up on your kind offer, then.
Let's go, Touya."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ivel: "Touya. Melvi said she wanted
to see you, too."
Touya: "Hmm, when you put it like that..."
Yamato: "Oh, what about Kasumi and Leone?"
Ymir: "We still have spare rooms at home,
so they can both stay with us."
Leone: "What? Is that all right?"
Ymir: "Of course."
Leone: "Th-Thanks..."
Kasumi: "With Touya-chan... Eek!♥"
Ai: "Hey, what are you getting so excited about all by yourself?
Hey, I want to stay, too!"
Ymir: "I'm sorry. We really don't have any more rooms."
Ai: "Ugh..."
Yamato: (whispering) "Don't worry. I'll keep a close eye on things."
Ai: (whispering) "I'm counting on you. You're the only one I can rely on."
Touya: "Hey, what are you whispering about over there?"
Ai: "N-Nothing! Well, then,
I suppose it's time I got some rest, too!"
Yamato: "Oh, what about Kasumi?"
Ymir: "We still have spare rooms at home,
so you can stay with us."
Kasumi: "What? Are you sure?"
Ymir: "It's a small house, but you're welcome."
Kasumi: "Not at all... I'd be delighted to stay with you."
Yamato: "Come to think of it, Kasumi, back then you often
came to stay at his house, didn't you?"
Kasumi: "Y-Yes... But only until elementary school..."
Yamato: "So you'll be sleeping under the same roof
for the first time in ages."
Kasumi: "With Touya-chan... Eek!♥"
Ai: "Hey, what are you getting so excited about all by yourself?"
Yamato: (whispering) "You don't have to worry so much, meow.
He's hardly Clovis. That boy has absolutely no initiative
when it comes to that sort of thing."
Ai: (whispering) "...That's true."
Touya: "Hey, what are you whispering about over there?"
Ai: "N-Nothing! Well, then,
I suppose it's time I got some rest, too!"
Bernst: "Is it all right to leave her as she is?"
????: "For the moment, it's not a serious problem.
She was only a 'stopgap' in the first place..."
Bernst: "...I see.
We'll leave her as she is, then."
Bernst: "Then at last,
it's time for the Doctor's 'revival'...?"
????: "Yes. Using the method you proposed."
Bernst: "If I remember correctly, you were the one
who opposed it as dangerous."
????: "The situation has changed. If we take any more time,
the day when the Spirit Mechs become an obstacle to us will soon be here.
We must at least call the Doctor back before then..."
Bernst: "That would mean being branded incompetent.
That person hated that more than anything."
????: "...Exactly.
I'll go in person this time.
Please prepare for the arrival."
Bernst: "Understood. Best of luck, then..."
Melvi: "Woooow."
Touya: "..."
Forzen: "Well, well..."
Leone: "...Hm?"
Forzen: "What an appetite."
Leone: "Oh..."
Paldia: "Oh, don't hold back.
You need to eat plenty while you're young.
Dear, how can she eat with you staring at her?"
Forzen: "Oh, right... It's a pleasure to watch.
Even most men couldn't eat that much... Ow, ow, ow!"
Leone: "..."
Paldia: "Don't mind him. Eat as much as you like.
If it's not enough, I'll make more right away."
Leone: "But..."
Forzen: "Exactly. There's no need to hold back at all.
When someone enjoys the food this much,
it makes cooking it worthwhile, doesn't it, dear?"
Paldia: "Yes. Have plenty."
Leone: "Thank you..."
Melvi: "I'm going to eat lots, too!"
Forzen: "All riiight! Daddy won't lose to you!"
Touya: "...Hm? Is that... Leone?
What's she doing at this hour?"
Follow Leone outside
Go back to sleep
Touya: "Hey. What are you doing out at this hour?"
Leone: "Oh... Well...
I couldn't sleep..."
Touya: "Are you worried about something?"
Leone: "No. The opposite.
I had so much fun today. So..."
Touya: "Fun? That was a pretty normal... Well, maybe not.
They're all good people, apart from that Forzen."
Leone: "Heh heh... They seem like such a happy,
warm family, don't they?
I've never had so much fun at a meal."
Touya: "...Wasn't your family like that?"
Leone: "...My dad and my big sister
didn't like me very much...
I was always in the way."
Touya: "..."
Leone: "...Even if they hate me, they're my family.
That bond can never disappear.
That's the one thing I can be sure will never change..."
Touya: "...So you look for your father even if he hates you?"
Leone: "Yes. That's what family is, isn't it?
But... Maybe what we saw at dinner, that feeling around the table,
is what 'family' really means..."
Touya: "...Hey, don't push yourself too hard.
When things hurt, it's okay to say so.
If you don't mind talking to me, I'll always listen."
Leone: "...You're kind."
Touya: "Well..."
Leone: "Achoo."
Touya: "W-We should probably head back..."
Leone: "Oh... I'd like to talk a little longer..."
Touya: "But you'll catch a cold."
Leone: "Is talking to me boring?"
Touya: "No, that's not what I meant..."
Leone: "Then just a little longer. Please?"
Touya: "H-Hey... Don't cling to me."
Leone: "We won't catch cold like this.
Besides... I don't want to be alone..."
Touya: "W-Well, if you're all right with this, I don't really mind..."
Leone: "Heh heh heh. You're warm, Touya."
